title: Phishing Awareness
tip: Check sender, urgency, links and attachments before acting. Report, don't forward.

title: Password Security
tip: Use long unique passphrases and a password manager.

title: MFA
tip: Prefer app or passkey MFA; never share codes.

title: Social Engineering
tip: Verify unusual requests via a second channel.

title: Safe Browsing
tip: Check the exact domain; avoid unexpected downloads.

title: Secure Wi-Fi
tip: Avoid sensitive logins on open networks.

title: Software Updates
tip: Turn on auto-update for OS, browser and apps.

title: Ransomware Awareness
tip: Keep tested offline backups; patch; least privilege.

title: Mobile Security
tip: Install apps only from official stores; lock your device.

title: Remote Work Security
tip: Use company VPN/SSO; lock your screen.

title: Cloud Account Security
tip: Enable MFA and review sharing links.

title: Incident Reporting
tip: Report early; speed matters more than blame.

title: AI-Enabled Scam Awareness
tip: Voice/video can be faked - verify requests out-of-band.
